response.original_title: Anne Boleyn: Arrest, Trial, and Execution
response.overview: The series re-examines the final 17 days, arrest, trial, and execution of Anne Boleyn in May 1536, utilizing original records and artifacts while visiting key historical locations such as the Tower of London, Greenwich Palace, and Westminster Hall. It highlights how Thomas Cromwell orchestrated the charges against the Queen under King Henry VIII.
response.tagline: The final days of Anne Boleyn
response.title: Anne Boleyn: Arrest, Trial, and Execution
